completed.C002: First-run guided tutorial with persisted seen/completed state and safe workflow education.
completed.C004: Community forum/blog with persistent backend, registered-user posting, reports, owner moderation and audit events.
completed.C005: Privacy-preserving visitor surveys with consent, first/returning/registered targeting, pseudonymous visitor identifiers, persistent responses and owner builder.
completed.C006: Session-derived Tips Center integrated with the shared full-stack core loop. Live/Android-synced evidence produces persistent coaching with provenance/evidence type, confidence, sample size, metrics and uncertainty.
completed.C007: Admin 100 is fully audited with 100 canonical capabilities, 75 implemented end-to-end and 25 explicitly isolated as provider-configuration-required monetization capabilities owned by C008. There are no remaining modelled Admin 100 entries.
completed.C009: All 49 canonical return-user features are implemented and testable. My Evidence Lab completes tip ratings, historical personal-best and efficiency views, fatigue/pause safeguards, safe evidence-use goals and achievements, coach inbox, screenshot/video/voice evidence intake, smart tags, saved views, and notification controls. Synthetic users remain excluded from real-user adoption counts.
completed.C010: Shared F.S.A. exact-telemetry fixture and validator added; integration CI validates the fixture and normalized contract.
completed.C011: Android Evidence Review v0.2 account-aware sync client is implemented; its legacy event aliases are normalized by the server into the shared core-loop vocabulary.
completed.C013: EGM4000-side authenticated F.S.A. telemetry bridge implemented with deployment-secret authentication, stable external-session mapping, duplicate protection and virtual/non-cash credit enforcement.
completed.C014: Persistent coaching experiment comparison implemented. Eligible coaching saves a baseline metric, follows the strongest current recommendation while the baseline is active, automatically links a later same-platform session, and reports Improved/Worsened/Unchanged/Insufficient Evidence with sample sizes, confidence and uncertainty across Web and Android. Random credit outcomes are excluded from success scoring.

incomplete.C003: Production owner/auth boundary exists in the full-stack foundation but still requires deployment hardening, recovery controls, production secret/provider configuration and final security validation.
incomplete.C008: A071-A095 monetization capabilities are explicitly named and remain provider-configuration-required; they are not yet all end-to-end implemented.

admin100.ownerUi: Owner Command Center -> Admin 100 implementation ledger
admin100.rule: A capability is not marked implemented unless a current route, persisted datastore, UI, or safety control concretely backs the claim. Provider-dependent A071-A095 capabilities stay visibly provider-configuration-required until C008 has real end-to-end provider-backed behavior.

returnUser49.rule: Return-user analytics describe authorized recorded history only. Personal bests, efficiency summaries, time patterns, ratings, goals and achievements must not be framed as predictions of random outcomes, causal proof, or profit guarantees.

patterns: pace increased while recorded results weakened
long session with no recorded break
coreLoopIntegration.rule: Analysis and C014 comparisons describe authorized recorded evidence only. Correlation is not causation. Random credit outcomes are never treated as proof coaching worked, and no hidden server state or future random outcome is predicted.

exactTelemetryBoundary.rule: Only the separately owned F.S.A. integration may submit exact telemetry.
